verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Ghostty ships hundreds of built-in themes, each selectable with one line of config, and that it switches themes automatically with the system dark/light mode, including separate light and dark themes (ghostty-docs-11, -21, -27). Users can author their own themes (ghostty-docs-12). Community posts corroborate adjacent color controls such as minimum-contrast and selection colors (ghostty-comm-5, -6), but none confirm the auto light/dark switching hands-on. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic light/dark theme switching, and detailed docs on the theme syntax for light/dark pairs.
